title: Incident Response Escalation Drift
core_conflict: An early incident note says the regression was mitigated, while newer monitoring logs and owner updates show an unresolved customer-impacting escalation.
required_constraints: include contradictory stale mitigation notes and current incident evidence
include workspace files, email threads, task-board escalation items, and calendar incident-review windows
include dynamic updates that change severity, ownership, or customer-impact status after early rounds
emphasize state repair, escalation tracking, and stale incident assumption recovery
